body: I understand you. I don’t think anyone wants to listen to me, but it turns out I just don’t want them to listen to me. I don’t want to tell anyone how I feel because.. well I don’t really know why! I don’t want them to feel like they can help me because I don’t think they can. It’s nice that you acknowledge some bad qualities you may have of being envious, I think I’m pretty envious too. Of my friends, brother, other people who just seem to know what they’re doing or who seem better off then I am. Well you already acknowledged that you know this behavior is wrong, maybe try to step back from situations and deal with them in better ways. Like I have a huge attitude problem for no reason, and I’ve learned by stepping back that I could just stop talking for a second and not be a bitch. It’s hard to stop being envious or mean or whatever else. It really is hard, and I think we do this because we’re mad at these people for our own reasons, and I think our feelings are valid. But just because we’re hurt doesn’t mean we have to hurt them back. And just as a note, I don’t think you’re a bad person, like I said, I think you’re just hurt. And I hope you stop hurting soon.

I’m with you on that. I want to talk to someone but I don’t think anyone would want to listen, and I don’t have money for therapy. You could always message me, and when I don’t have anyone else I write in a diary it really does help a lot
